# 40th Lucille Lortel Awards

| venue = Skirball Center for Performing Arts
}}
The 40th Lucille Lortel Awards were held on May 4, 2025, recognizing excellence in Off-Broadway productions during the 2024-25 season. Nominations were announced on April 2, 2025, with Drag: The Musical, Our Class and Three Houses receiving the most nominations with six each. The Lortel Awards are jointly produced by the Off-Broadway League and the Lucille Lortel Theatre, with support from Theatre Development Fund.
Winners and nominees
The 2024-2025 Lucille Lortel Awards nominations were announced on April 1, 2025 by Francis Jue and Krysta Rodriguez. Drag: The Musical, Our Class, and Three Houses were the most nominated productions, receiving six nominations.
The ceremony was held at the Skirball Center for Performing Arts on May 4, 2025.
